description: Implementation of EmailService interface, providing methods to send simple emails and HTML emails using Thymeleaf templates within a Spring Boot application.

classes.name: EmailServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for email functionalities, including sending simple text and HTML emails with Thymeleaf templating.

methods.name: sendSimpleMessage
methods.description: Sends a plain text email to the specified recipient.

methods.name: sendMessageUsingThymeleafTemplate
methods.description: Generates an HTML email from a Thymeleaf template with provided model data and sends it.

methods.name: sendHtmlMessage
methods.description: Helper method to send an HTML email using MimeMessage.
